root_cause: Transactions experienced L2/L3 commercial card downgrades on RuPay debit transactions resulting in undercharged MDR based on an illustrative benchmark.
diagnosis: A pattern of commercial card downgrades was detected across 9 RuPay debit transactions, causing a variance between charged fees and modeled expected rates. Note that the source status is illustrative, indicating the baseline uses a modeled benchmark.
action_rationale: Providing Level 2 and Level 3 data fields for commercial card processing prevents transaction downgrades and ensures accurate processing fees.
